gold.taskTitle: Apply for a library card at local branch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a library card at their local library branch.

questions.title: Which specific library branch do you plan to visit?
questions.description: Identify the exact library branch the user intends to go to.

questions.title: Have you applied for a library card there before?
questions.description: Determine if this is a first-time application or a renewal.

questions.title: Do you know what documents or ID are required?
questions.description: Find out if the user already knows the required documents, such as proof of address or government-issued ID.

questions.title: Will you apply in person or online if available?
questions.description: Clarify the user's preferred or intended method of application.

questions.title: Is this card for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Determine if the application is for the user personally or on behalf of another person, such as a child.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or target date in mind?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has a specific timeframe or urgency for completing this task.

questions.title: What do you mainly plan to use the card for?
questions.description: Understand the user's primary purpose, such as borrowing physical books, accessing digital resources, or attending events.
